entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The gentle breeze tickled his face like a feather.
entries.zh: 温柔的微风把他的脸像羽毛一样痒痒.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The leaves waved gently in the breeze.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A welcome breeze sprang up and brought relief from the burning heat.
entries.zh: 一阵欢迎的微风涌现出来,并带来了从燃烧的热量中解脱出来.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The warm, gentle breeze stirred their hair and caressed their faces.
entries.zh: 温暖温柔的微风唤起他们的头发 抚摸他们的脸

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The stammering gusts tore the clouds like a shredded veil.
entries.zh: 一阵阵断续的狂风把云层撕得像破碎的面纱。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The car rocked and shuddered under the force of the wind.
entries.zh: 车在风力下摇晃而颤抖.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The branches quivered as they were stabbed by the wind.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The wind was ferocious. It screamed over the house and beat like a fist against the roof.
entries.zh: 风势凶猛,在屋上大喊大叫,像拳头对着屋顶打.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The wind was lashing against the windows and hammering at the glass.
entries.zh: 风向对着窗户,在玻璃上敲锤子。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The wind whined through the trees and bent the tops of the branches.
entries.zh: 风吹过树,弯曲树枝的顶部.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: A breath of wind ghosted past him, tickling his ear like a feather and making the skin at the back of his neck prickle with foreboding.
entries.zh: 一口气风鬼过他身旁,把耳朵痒得像羽毛一样,用前锋把脖子后部的皮肤刺成刺骨.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The trunks arched in the swirling wind, which bent their branches and stole their leaves.
entries.zh: 树干在摇摆的风中拱起,树枝弯曲,偷走了树叶.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: The wind screamed like a boiling kettle as it blustered around the house.
entries.zh: 风在屋里摇晃时,像沸腾的壶一样尖叫.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: He staggered back and forth, side to side, struggling to stay on his feet, as the wind shoved and tugged at him fiercely, hunting him like a beast.
entries.zh: 他前后交错,一面夹击,挣扎着站稳脚跟,当风猛烈地推倒和拖拽着他,像野兽一样猎杀他.

entries.zh: 一个巨大的断头台的闪电片 横跨地平线 以鲜明的蓝白照亮它

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Thunder boomed through the house, shaking it to its core, and streaking through the streets like an exploding firework.
entries.zh: 雷电从屋里冲过去,摇动到核心, 像爆炸的烟火一样冲向街道。

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: Suddenly, dazzling arrows of lightning tore the night sky apart, ripping its belly and flooding the land.
entries.zh: 突然,闪电闪烁的箭头将夜空撕裂,撕裂腹部,淹没大地.

entries.label: Sentences
entries.en: It was as if the heavens were being torn apart by the jagged spears of lightning – the thunder howling their pain.
entries.zh: 仿佛天被闪电的长矛撕裂了一样,雷鸣着他们的痛苦。
